summary: AVK | SEG VP Delivery: after the client's revised brief the GC/PMC target list grew from 41 to 85 and is still growing; statistically that should give a shortlist of 3-5. Ensar engaged Raj Chaladi, though Ward doubts he is ultimately right. Danny Cross (Friday) and Neil Lock look like the right seniority. Alex Mariage and Tom Powlay are too junior for VP but could be Ops Director candidates.
